say:3:1035217002:1.text: Alright, look... I'll tell you a secret, but it stays between us!
say:3:1035217002:1.source_cn: 咳咳，行吧。那我偷偷告诉你，你可别告诉别人啊！
say:3:1035217002:1.male: Alright, look... I'll tell you a secret, but it stays between us!
say:3:1035217002:1.female: Alright, look... I'll tell you a secret, but it stays between us!

say:4:1035217003:1.text: There's a legend about a man who threw moonstones into the lake and gained divine wisdom, so a lot of people started copying him.
say:4:1035217003:1.source_cn: 之前有个投月光石获得神启的传说。所以后来就有很多人跑那...

say:7:1035217005:1.text: Correct! But to be precise, with the wind and current, we're also downstream of the Moon Temple!
say:7:1035217005:1.source_cn: 诶，对咯！不过准确来说是月神殿下游的湖边！
say:7:1035217005:1.male: Correct! But to be precise, with the wind and current, we're also downstream of the Moon Temple!
say:7:1035217005:1.female: Correct! But to be precise, with the wind and current, we're also downstream of the Moon Temple!

say:8:1035217006:1.text: Do you know what that means?

say:8:1035217006:1.female: Do you know what that means?

say:9:1035217007:1.text: If we throw a net here, we might be able to gather up some moonstones!
say:9:1035217007:1.source_cn: 咱们就在这放个网，说不定能打捞上来不少宝石呢！

choice:2:0:1.text: I just heard you say it.
